summary: The predictor network MLP_Predictor initializes its linear layers using PyTorch's default reset_parameters (Kaiming uniform initialization, as noted in the code comment) rather than Glorot initialization.

evidence.text: In all our experiments, we use the AdamW optimizer (Kingma & Ba, 2015;Gugger & Howard, 2018) with weight decay set to 10 -5 , and all models initialized using Glorot initialization (Glorot & Bengio, 2010).
